case_title.reason: Matches the caption, Sunita v. State of Haryana.

number_of_accused.reason: Only the appellant's liability is decided; the co-accused were acquitted at trial.

accused_age.reason: No age of the accused is given.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: No statement on wealth or class.

victim_gender.reason: Sushila, a woman, is the victim.

victim_age.reason: Only the children's ages are given, not the victim's.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Relative: appellant is daughter of the cousin of the victim's husband's father, so familiar with the victim. The estate suit concerned Baburam's estate (the appellant's partner) and was with witnesses PW-4 and PW-5, not the victim.
accused_victim_relationship.quote: Sunita is daughter of cousin of father of Shish Pal, therefore, she is familiar with the deceased.
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Relative link is right, but the estate suit was filed against Baburam's family, not a 'victim's co-accused relative'.

offence_category.reason: Convicted under s.302 IPC for murder.

evidence_type.reason: Case rests on circumstantial evidence: last seen, DNA, confession, recovery.

confession.quote: extra-judicial confession made to Kashmir Singh (PW-12)... Such statement is again untenable.

trial_court_outcome.quote: stands convicted for the murder of Sushila... by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, Karnal on January 13, 2006.

high_court_outcome.quote: The appeal against the said judgment was dismissed on March 25, 2008.

final_outcome.quote: The appellant is acquitted of the charges levelled against her.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Should describe the first witness as the accused's step-son, not a relative of the victim's family, and omit court findings such as the witnesses' enmity and the unestablished cause and place of death.
neutral_facts.quote: Neeraj (PW-4), son of Baburam... he was a step son of the appellant.
neutral_facts.reason: Misdescribes PW-4's relationship and includes judicial findings that hint at the outcome.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment states no punishment for s.302.

physical_harm.quote: There is no evidence in the manner of cause of death or place of death available on record.
physical_harm.reason: Death and burnt body; cause not established.

premeditation_planning.reason: Court made no finding of premeditation; the entry is acceptable.

motive.quote: Therefore, the primary motive is not made out.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: The prosecution has been able to prove only death of Sushila on the basis of DNA test

witness_credibility.quote: such statement has to be taken with pinch of salt as it is by a person, who is inimical to the accused.

post_offence_conduct.quote: recovery of Scooty on the basis of disclosure statement made by the appellant.

bail_history.quote: The bail bonds shall stand discharged.

procedural_irregularity.quote: Sushila went missing on January 3, 2004 but no missing report was lodged.

other_sentence_order.quote: She be set at liberty, if not wanted in any other case.
